text:
Lina (People Ops): Drafting a tiny set of manager "microtemplates" for goals + feedback. Aim: slip into a 1:1, paste into a review form, or send async. Please quick-review. :memo:

Ben (Eng): Nice. Can they be 3 lines max? I want something my ICs can actually write in 5 min.

Lina (People Ops): Yes — 3 lines, plus two optional tags: [Evidence] and [Risk/Opportunity]. Example below.

Lina (People Ops): Microtemplate (copy-paste):
```
Goal: Increase P95 for chat-infer by 12% in us-west
Outcome: P95 -12% (dash-442) | Deploy PR#2765
Ask: Need help with canary schedule; low confidence in metrics [Evidence:A] [Risk:Medium]
```

Aria (Manager): Love the Ask line. Can we include a one-word "Beneficiary" tag so cross-impact is explicit?

Lina (People Ops): Added: example with Beneficiary. Also a manager feedback micro-script (1 sentence) for 1:1s: "Tell me one change you shipped that moved a metric and one thing you want my help with this cycle."

Kai (People Ops): Recommend a short peer-quote prompt managers can paste: "Peer: One-sentence on where this person moved the needle - <name>". Encourage but not required.

Aria (Manager): Small ops note: include a checklist for calibration threads: "Dashboard link present? Rollout doc linked? Any post-rollout incidents?" keeps artifacts in front of reviewers.

Lina (People Ops): Good call. Also adding a tiny hiring/handoff trigger footer so managers know when to start a growth or role-change request after reviews: "If promotion/growth expected, file Hiring Ops request within 10 days -> template link."

hr-bot: Draft published: https://handbook.redwood.company/people-ops/manager-microtemplates (internal)

Ben (Eng): I'll trial with my ICs for async self-reviews this cycle and share uptake metrics (time-to-complete).

Lina (People Ops): Plan: fold in these tweaks (Beneficiary tag, peer prompt, ops checklist, hiring trigger) and push final to handbook tomorrow. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
